create_npu_moe_quant_scheme: create a quantization scheme for NPU W8A8 INT8 dynamic MoE with channelwise weight and per-token dynamic input quantization
create_moe_layer_weights: create int8 weight parameters and float32 per-channel scales for a fused MoE layer with w13 and w2 weights
process_moe_weights_after_loading: process MoE layer weights after loading by invoking the NPU W8A8 INT8 dynamic MoE kernel
create_moe_runner_config: create an MoE runner configuration for a quantized MoE layer with a given MoeRunnerConfig
apply_moe_quantized_weights: apply quantized MoE weights to a layer using a dispatch output and return the combine input
